explication: User Scanner is a two-mode OSINT application for checking email registrations and username profiles across many external platforms. The principal workflow accepts a target and scan scope, dispatches platform checks, collects availability and profile metadata, and presents or exports results. Optional branches add recursive cross-scans, Hudson Rock breach checks, and MCP access for AI agents. The README documents additional runtime capabilities, including proxying, concurrency, alias generation, and report formats; sampled source confirms selected orchestration, result handling, platform checks, and MCP wiring, but not every feature’s internal implementation.
